decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication is a growing, sustainability-driven segment adjacent to the firm's machine-tool customer base, and keeping it on the modular platform costs little while its market prospects remain uncertain and potentially valuable.

A hydrocyclone coolant filter fits squarely within the core filtration portfolio, shares components and service infrastructure, and has low holding cost, so there is no evidence justifying abandonment of this option.

Gravity band filters are a standard, low-cost complement to the firm's coolant filtration systems that supports one-stop delivery, making it cheap to keep while demand from expanding customers continues.
